panels.visual: The great palace of Knossos with red columns and bright painted walls, Glauka the owl flying above
panels.caption: Knossos was the biggest palace of the Minoans, about three thousand five hundred years ago.

panels.visual: A bird's-eye view of a vast tangled maze of rooms, more than a thousand, a tiny lost visitor in the middle
panels.caption: More than a thousand rooms, all tangled together. People say this is where the Labyrinth story came from.

panels.visual: A Minoan wall painting in painted fresco style: a young man somersaulting over the back of a charging bull while a girl holds its horns
panels.caption: On the palace walls are paintings of young people who somersault over a charging bull.

panels.visual: A real bull charging in a courtyard with a trio of young acrobats in flight, dust and speed lines, the crowd cheering
panels.caption: Nobody knows if it was a sport, a ritual, or both. The bull was very real.
